'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Ganden Yanaga LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ganden Yanaga]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Cam Solusar
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
